title: Learning When to Think: Utility-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Efficient Text Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.21030v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning-conditioned embeddings can improve retrieval by progressively refining semantic constraints. However, additional reasoning may introduce over-generalized or semantically noisy abstractions that weaken retrieval specificity. Existing methods largely supervise reasoning through final retrieval outcomes, providing limited guidance over the refinement process itself. We propose AURA, a framework that directly supervises intermediate reasoning states according to how well they separate relevant documents from hard distractors. AURA further trains a lightweight utility estimator over prefix-conditioned embeddings to adapt reasoning depth at inference time. On the reasoning-intensive BRIGHT benchmark, AURA-4B achieves 34.7 average nDCG@10 while using 2.8 reasoning steps and 96 generated tokens per query. Under matched deployment conditions, adaptive stopping reduces latency from 4.6 to 0.76 seconds relative to full-trajectory reason

translated_title: 学习何时思考：效用引导的自适应推理以实现高效文本检索
translated_abstract: 推理条件化的嵌入可以通过逐步细化语义约束来提升检索效果。然而，额外的推理可能引入过度泛化或语义上有噪声的抽象，从而削弱检索的特异性。现有方法主要通过最终检索结果来监督推理，对细化过程本身的指导有限。我们提出了AURA框架，它根据中间推理状态区分相关文档与困难干扰文档的能力来直接监督这些中间状态。AURA还训练了一个基于前缀条件化嵌入的轻量级效用估计器，以便在推理时自适应调整推理深度。在推理密集型的BRIGHT基准上，AURA-4B实现了34.7的平均nDCG@10，同时每个查询仅使用2.8个推理步骤和96个生成token。在相同的部署条件下，自适应停止机制相比完整轨迹推理将延迟从4.6秒降低至0.76秒。
tldr: 论文提出AURA框架，通过直接监督中间推理状态区分相关文档与困难干扰项，并利用轻量级效用估计器在推理时自适应调整推理深度，从而在BRIGHT基准上以极少推理步骤和生成token实现高检索精度并大幅降低延迟。
en_tdlr: AURA directly supervises intermediate reasoning states by how well they separate relevant documents from hard distractors, and employs a lightweight utility estimator to adaptively adjust reasoning depth at inference, achieving high retrieval accuracy on BRIGHT with minimal steps, tokens, and latency.
